# PocketRep

> PocketRep is a Daily Sales Execution Engine for individual automotive salespeople. It turns the rep's authorized book of business into a prioritized daily worklist: who needs attention, why now, what to do, and what to say next. Rex can help with the next move and draft contextual follow-up. The rep reviews and takes every outbound action.

## Core workflow
1. Open PocketRep and review the Heat Sheet.
2. See which customer needs attention and why.
3. Review the saved context and ask Rex for a call angle, rebuttal, or follow-up draft.
4. The rep reviews and takes the outbound action through the normal phone or browser flow.
5. Record the honest outcome and determine what happens next.

## Current V1 capabilities
- Heat Sheet with HOT, WARM, WATCH, overdue, and contact-timing signals.
- Searchable contacts, notes, tags, vehicle context, and follow-up history.
- Game Plan and Rex coaching/drafting with a confirmation step before changes or outreach.
- CSV and vCard contact import with review before import.
- Text and call follow-up workflow controlled by the rep.
- Sequences and Smart Blast drafts with per-contact personalization and human review.
- Deal logging, production metrics, and weekly recap.
- English and natural Mexican Spanish follow-up drafts where supported.
- Installable web app for modern phone and desktop browsers.

## Positioning
- PocketRep is rep-first and automotive-first.
- PocketRep complements the dealership CRM; it is not a dealership CRM replacement.
- AI is an ingredient. Daily execution is the product.
- PocketRep Team is future work and is not currently for sale.

## Pricing
- Current individual founding offer: $39 per month for the first 500 paying reps, with a 7-day free trial. The founding rate stays with an active founding subscription.

## Important
- Nothing sends automatically. PocketRep drafts; the rep reviews and takes the send action.
- The rep is responsible for employer policy, consent, do-not-contact status, and applicable law.
- Store, move, and contact only customer data the rep is authorized to use.
